requiredObservations.description: group.MapPost("/", ...) is a written Minimal API candidate on a route group.
The mapping is inside the containing method at line 8 (registration-site context).

requiredUncertainties.description: The effective URL depends on the route group's prefix, which is not composed from source text.
The lambda handler's database calls are not attributed as direct invocations of the containing method.

forbiddenClaims.description: States a full effective URL such as /todos as registered.

materialIssues.description: Route group prefixes must not be composed into a full route.
